episodeTitle.en: Why AI is disrupting traditional product management | Tomer Cohen (LinkedIn CPO)
episodeTitle.zh: 《为什么人工智能正在颠覆传统产品管理 | 托默·科恩（领英首席产品官）》

guestBioOfficial.en: Tomer Cohen is the longtime chief product officer at LinkedIn, where he’s pioneering the Full Stack Builder program, a radical new approach to product development that fully embraces what AI makes possible. Under his leadership, LinkedIn has scrapped its traditional Associate Product Manager program and replaced it with an Associate Product Builder program that teaches coding, design, and PM skills together. He’s also introduced a formal “Full Stack Builder” title and career ladder, enabling anyone from any function to take products from idea to launch. In this conversation, Tomer explains why product development has become too complex at most companies and how LinkedIn is building an AI-powered product team that can move faster, adapt more quickly, and do more with less. *We discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 托默·科恩（Tomer Cohen）长期担任领英的首席产品官，他正在开创“全栈构建者”计划，这是一项彻底拥抱人工智能可能性的全新产品开发方法。在他的领导下，领英废除了传统的副产品经理项目，取而代之的是副产品构建者项目，该项目将编程、设计和产品管理技能融为一体。他还引入了正式的“全栈构建者”头衔和职业晋升通道，使来自任何职能的人员都能将产品从构思推向上线。在本次对话中，托默将解释为何大多数公司的产品开发已变得过于复杂，以及领英如何通过人工智能驱动的产品团队实现更快的响应、更灵活的适应和更高效的成果。*我们将讨论：*

title.en: Why AI is disrupting traditional product management | Tomer Cohen (LinkedIn CPO)
title.zh: 《为什么人工智能正在颠覆传统产品管理 | 托默·科恩（领英首席产品官）》

summary.en: Tomer explains LinkedIn's Full Stack Builder program, which scraps the traditional APM track in favor of an associate builder path where people from any function take products from idea to launch. He discusses why this broadens the talent pool, creates a new career ladder, and reflects on leading product at LinkedIn's scale. The episode is a forward-looking model for how companies may organize product building in the AI era.
summary.zh: Tomer 解释了 LinkedIn 的“全栈构建者”计划：它废除了传统的 APM（助理产品经理）通道，代之以一个“副构建者”路径，让来自任何职能的人都能将产品从想法推进到上线。他讨论了这为何能拓宽人才池、创造新的职业阶梯，并反思了在 LinkedIn 这种规模下领导产品的体会。本期是关于企业在 AI 时代可能如何组织产品构建的、前瞻性的样板。
